he_version: Midrash Tanhuma haKadum veHaYashan, S. Buber, 1885
en_version: Midrash Tanhuma, S. Buber Recension; trans. by John T. Townsend, 1989.
he: ויעבר אלהים רוח. איזה רוח (עובר) [העביר] הקב"ה על (הרוח) [הארץ] ועל המים והחזירן כשם שהיו מתחילתן, שנא' ויעבר אלהים רוח על הארץ, [וישכו המים] וכתיב ורוח אלהים מרחפת על פני המים <small>(שם א ב)</small>, אותו הרוח העביר עליהן ונחו מיד.
en: (Gen. 8:1, cont.:) <small>AND GOD CAUSED A WIND TO PASS < OVER THE EARTH</small> >. {Which wind? The Holy One passes over the wind} [Which one? The Holy One caused a wind to pass over the earth] and over the waters. Thus he restored them just as they were at their beginning. It is so stated (ibid.): <small>AND GOD CAUSED A WIND TO PASS OVER THE EARTH, [AND THE WATERS SUBSIDED]</small>. It is also written (in Gen. 1:2): <small>AND THE WIND OF GOD WAS HOVERING OVER FACE OF THE WATERS</small>. That very wind he caused to pass over them, and immediately they settled down.
